fteqw.defaultConfigText:
hostname "Insta Game FTEQW FFA 4-12"
rcon_password "changeme"

// Allow compatible clients to download missing assets from the server.
allow_download 1

deathmatch 1
teamplay 0
coop 0
timelimit 12
fraglimit 40
pausable 0
samelevel 0
noexit 0
sv_aim 1
temp1 0

// FrikBot settings.
// skill 0-3; bots use this when added via impulse 100.
skill 1

// FrikBot bot persistence: these cvars are read by WaypointWatch on every
// map load. saved1=1 sets OPT_SAVEBOTS; scratch1 is the bitmask of bots
// to restore (bits 0-3 = bots 1-4, sum = 15); scratch2 packs each bot's
// skill in 2 bits (all four at skill 1 → 1|4|16|64 = 85).
// FrikBot resets scratch1 to the live bot set at end of each map, so the
// count naturally follows humans joining/leaving across map changes.
saved1 1
scratch1 15
scratch2 85

alias nextmap_dm1 "map dm1; alias nextmap nextmap_dm2"
alias nextmap_dm2 "map dm2; alias nextmap nextmap_dm3"
alias nextmap_dm3 "map dm3; alias nextmap nextmap_dm4"
alias nextmap_dm4 "map dm4; alias nextmap nextmap_dm5"
alias nextmap_dm5 "map dm5; alias nextmap nextmap_dm6"
alias nextmap_dm6 "map dm6; alias nextmap nextmap_dm1"
alias nextmap "nextmap_dm2"

map dm6

ioquake3.defaultConfigText:
set sv_hostname "Insta Game Quake III Arena"
set g_motd "Warm up and frag out."
seta rconPassword "changeme"

// Server basics
set dedicated 2
set sv_maxclients 12
set sv_privateClients 0
set sv_pure 1
set sv_allowDownload 1

// Deathmatch (FFA) settings
set g_gametype 0
set timelimit 15
set fraglimit 50
set g_weaponRespawn 5
set g_forcerespawn 5

// Bots — fill to 4 players minimum, kick when humans join
set bot_enable 1
set bot_minplayers 4
set g_spskill 4

// Map rotation — mid-size maps well-suited for 4-12 players FFA.
set d1 "set nextmap vstr d2; map q3dm6"
set d2 "set nextmap vstr d3; map q3dm7"
set d3 "set nextmap vstr d4; map q3dm14"
set d4 "set nextmap vstr d5; map q3dm17"
set d5 "set nextmap vstr d1; map q3dm12"
set nextmap "vstr d1"

vstr nextmap

itemLines: set d{{index1}} "map {{value}}; set nextmap vstr d{{nextIndex1}}"

openarena.defaultConfigText:
// insta-game managed config: start
set sv_hostname "Insta Game OpenArena"
set g_motd "OpenArena InstaGib FFA"
seta rconPassword "changeme"

set dedicated 2
set sv_maxclients 12
set g_gametype 0
set g_instantgib 1
set bot_minplayers 4
set timelimit 8
set fraglimit 30
set capturelimit 8
set sv_pure 1
set sv_allowDownload 1

set d1 "map oa_ctf4ish; set nextmap vstr d2"
set d2 "map oa_dm5; set nextmap vstr d3"
set d3 "map oa_shine; set nextmap vstr d4"

q2repro.defaultConfigText:
set hostname "Insta Game Quake II FFA"

// Short public FFA rounds tuned for roughly 4-12 players.
set deathmatch 1
set coop 0
set maxclients 12
set timelimit 8
set fraglimit 30
set public 1

// Keep movement responsive and make joining with custom assets easy.
set allow_download 1
set allow_download_maps 1
set allow_download_models 1
set allow_download_players 1
set allow_download_sounds 1

// Rotate through the classic DM maps that work well for smaller public games.
set sv_maplist "q2dm1 q2dm2 q2dm3 q2dm5 q2dm6 q2dm7 q2dm8"

map q2dm1
